title: 第9章 情断义绝第10章 林中遭遇
lines: “小瑜，峰儿，他现在在哪里，过得怎么样了？”
一处无名山谷中，苏母担忧的看着夏侯瑜问道。
不久前，夏侯瑜找到了这里，将事情简单的和苏母说了一遍。
“夫人，对不起，我也不知道他现在在哪里，不过您放心，我已经派人在寻找了。
我相信，肯定会找他的。”
夏侯瑜安慰道。
看着眼前的妇人，夏侯瑜满脸的愧疚。
短短不过三日时间，苏母便仿佛衰老了十岁，脸上尽是憔悴。
“峰儿！
我的峰儿啊！”
苏母哭泣道。
这三天，她的心始终悬着。
“夫人，一定要保重身体，如果楚峰回来，看到您这般模样，会心疼的。”
夏侯瑜紧握着苏母的手。
“是啊，夫人，您一定要保重身体，我们相信，小少爷一定能够安然无恙的回来的。”
旁边几位楚家的下人，也是劝解道。
“我知道，我知道，我会保重身体的。”
苏母很快便止住了眼泪。
夏侯瑜紧握了双拳。
“夏皇，夏侯武，为什么，你们为何要如此做？”
她到现在，都一直不明白，大夏皇室为何会对楚家动手。
“楚峰，你在哪里？”
夏侯瑜摸了摸胸口，那里有个一块碎片，和楚峰的一样。
就在这时，碎了上传来一阵温热。
“难道是楚峰！”
她连忙看向山谷之外。
那里，一道身影缓缓浮现。
“娘，峰儿不孝，来晚了！”
楚峰来了。
他迅速的走到苏母面前，跪了下去。
“峰儿，我的好峰儿！”
苏母拉起楚峰，紧紧将他抱在怀中，不断的抽泣着。
半晌后，苏母这才松开双手。
“楚峰，对不起，我不是故意的，我真的不知道，他会…”
夏侯瑜走到楚峰面前道歉。
“不用说了，事情我都知道了，你可以走了，我们之间的情分，就此断绝。”
楚峰转身打断了夏侯瑜。
“楚峰，我…”
夏侯瑜听到楚峰那不含一丝感情的话语，脸色瞬间煞白了起来。
“还不走，难道还要我亲自动手吗？”
楚峰怒吼道。
夏侯瑜泪如雨下，看了楚峰一眼，转身朝着山谷之外走去。
楚峰看着夏侯瑜的背影，最终还是忍住了。
他感应到夏侯瑜身上的碎片。
但是，他却没有将其夺下来。
content_en:
"Xiao Yu, Feng'er, where is he now and how is he doing?"
In an unknown valley, Mother Su looked at Xia Houyu worriedly and asked.
Not long ago, Xia Houyu found this place and briefly explained the matter to Su's mother.
"Madam, I'm sorry, I don't know where he is now, but don't worry, I have sent people to look for him.
I believe that I will definitely find him. "
Xia Houyu comforted him.
Looking at the woman in front of him, Xia Houyu's face was filled with guilt.
In just three days, Su's mother seemed to have aged ten years, and her face looked haggard.
"Feng'er!
My peak! "
Mother Su cried.
These three days, her heart has been hanging.
"Madam, you must take care of yourself. If Chu Feng comes back and sees you like this, he will feel distressed."
Xia Houyu held Su's mother's hand tightly.
"Yes, madam, you must take care of yourself. We believe that the young master will be able to come back safe and sound."
Several servants of the Chu family nearby also tried to persuade him.
"I know, I know, I will take care of myself."
Mother Su quickly stopped crying.
Xia Houyu clenched his fists.
"Emperor Xia, Xia Houwu, why, why do you do this?"
Until now, she still doesn't understand why the Daxia royal family took action against the Chu family.
"Chu Feng, where are you?"
Xia Houyu touched his chest, and there was a fragment there, which was the same as Chu Feng's.
At this moment, a burst of warmth came from the broken piece.
"Could it be Chu Feng!"
She quickly looked outside the valley.
There, a figure slowly emerged.
"Mom, Feng'er is unfilial and you're late!"
Chu Feng is here.
He quickly walked to Mother Su and knelt down.
"Feng'er, my good Feng'er!"
Mother Su pulled up Chu Feng and held him tightly in her arms, sobbing continuously.
After a while, Mother Su let go of her hands.
"Chu Feng, I'm sorry, I didn't mean it. I really didn't know, he would..."
Xia Houyu walked up to Chu Feng and apologized.
"No need to say more, I know everything. You can leave. The friendship between us will be severed."
Chu Feng turned around and interrupted Xia Houyu.
"Chu Feng, I..."
When Xia Houyu heard Chu Feng's words without a trace of emotion, his face instantly turned pale.
"If you don't leave yet, do you still want me to do it myself?"
Chu Feng roared.
Xia Houyu burst into tears, glanced at Chu Feng, turned around and walked out of the valley.
Chu Feng looked at Xia Houyu's back and finally held back.
He sensed the fragments on Xia Houyu's body.
However, he did not take it off.
